transcript.text: While debugging an unrelated tenant-isolation test this morning, I found that the cache key omits tenant ID for the /account/profile and /billing/status routes. This means cached responses could be served to the wrong tenant — a serious data isolation issue. Those two routes must bypass the cache entirely until the key is corrected. I haven't filed the ticket for this yet, but I'm raising it now because it directly affects what we can safely deploy on Thursday.

commitments.detail: Casey's cache-invalidation rehearsal result showing 90-second propagation delay must be formally documented in the deployment record before Thursday's deployment.

Riley must file a ticket for the missing tenant ID in cache keys for /account/profile and /billing/status routes so the key can be corrected and those routes can be re-evaluated for caching in a future deployment.
Invalidation-lag monitoring must be in place for all cached routes before the caching change goes to production.
Per standard deployment routine, backend engineering and SRE must review the final operating settings — 15-second TTL, 120-minute canary, and route exclusions — before Morgan's approval is finalized.
